Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: operational proof for no-train + ownership mapping

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Medicore is excited about Redwood's latency profile. Our procurement/legal team have a couple of asks before we can sign the DPA + MSA: a concise set of operational artifacts that prove the no-training/no-derivative commitments and explain how prompt/response ownership will be handled in practice. Specifically they asked for: 

1) A short written confirmation of the "no-training" commitment (how customer inputs are excluded from model training/pipeline), plus an ops-level description we can attach to the DPA.
2) Evidence of subprocessor controls and a current inventory (including any third-party inference optimizers or telemetry sinks).
3) A clear explanation of output ownership: what rights Medicore will have to model outputs and whether Redwood reserves any derivative or reuse rights.
4) Any cross-border transfer safeguards (SCCs, onshore routing, or encryption-at-rest notes) that apply to EU data.

Can you send those materials or point me to a packet we can share with Legal? If it's easier, a single PDF with an index would work. We need to present something to our CISO and GC by Monday.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Voss
